raw_snippet: In early January 2024, the leading closed- weight model outperformed the top open-weight model by 8.04% on the Chatbot Arena Leaderboard. By February 2025, this gap had narrowed to 1.70%.
value_text: AI Index 2025: the best closed model's lead over the best open one on Chatbot Arena fell from 8.04% in January 2024 to 1.70% in February 2025.
